```{r}
# load data
library(forecast)
library(lubridate)

df_1819 <- readRDS("data/train_test_split/df_1819.rds")
df_20   <- readRDS("data/train_test_split/df_20.rds")

# 1) Build hourly ts with daily seasonality
y_1819 <- ts(df_1819$electricity_demand, frequency = 24)

# 2) 80/20 split WITHOUT dropping ts attributes
n <- length(y_1819)
n_train <- floor(0.8 * n)

y_train <- window(y_1819, end = time(y_1819)[n_train])
y_test  <- window(y_1819, start = time(y_1819)[n_train + 1])

# 3) Quick sanity check (should be 24, not 1)
start(y_train); end(y_train); frequency(y_train)
start(y_test);  end(y_test);  frequency(y_test)
```


```{r}
spec <- spec.pgram(
  y_1819,
  log = "no",
  detrend = FALSE,
  demean = TRUE,
  taper = 0.1,
  plot = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
top_idx <- order(spec$spec, decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
data.frame(
  frequency = spec$freq[top_idx],
  period = 1/spec$freq[top_idx],
  power = spec$spec[top_idx]
)
```


```{r}
fit_tbats <- tbats(
  y_train,
  seasonal.periods = c(24, 168),
   use.trend = TRUE,
  use.box.cox = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
h_test <- length(y_test)

fc_test <- forecast(fit_tbats, h = h_test)

plot(fc_test)
lines(y_test, col = "red")
```
```{r}
accuracy(fc_test, y_test)
```

# try other frequency
```{r}
fit_tbats2 <- tbats(
  y_train,
  seasonal.periods = c(24,168, 187.5),
   use.trend = TRUE,
  use.box.cox = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
h_test <- length(y_test)

fc_test2 <- forecast(fit_tbats2, h = h_test)

plot(fc_test2)
lines(y_test, col = "red")
```
```{r}
accuracy(fc_test2, y_test)
```
```{r}
fit_tbats3 <- tbats(

```

```{r}

fc_test3 <- forecast(fit_tbats3, h = h_test)
```
